advertising.title: MEDICXI – SEEKER
advertising.description: Behind every medical breakthrough lies a long journey of conviction, resilience and collaboration. Seeker reveals the human reality of biotech innovation and the determination required to transform scientific ambition into life-changing treatments.

advertising.title: NESCENS x LA RESERVE
advertising.description: Where advanced science meets the art of hospitality. The campaign presents the Nescens Better-Aging programmes at La Réserve Genève, combining medical expertise, innovative treatments and a deeply personal approach to wConceptell-being.

advertising.title: JAEGER-LECOULTRE – WW 26
advertising.description: For Watches & Wonders 2026, the campaign reimagines the Vallée de Joux as a dreamlike stage, creating a visual world where landscape, movement and watchmaking come together through unexpected perspectives.

advertising.title: EBEL – SPORT CLASSIC 115TH
advertising.description: A film marking 115 years of Ebel, built around the Sport Classic. Shot in light-filled architectural interiors, it lets the maison’s signature wave bracelet move quietly through a world of timeless elegance.

advertising.title: CONCORD – NEW MARINER
advertising.description: To accompany the launch of the new Mariner Collection, Concord invites you on a journey to the heart of Lake Biel and its surrounding landscapes, where water, light and time come together.

advertising.title: JAEGER LECOULTRE – HOLIDAY REVERSO 23
advertising.description: Inspired by three floral creations imagined by Brendi Wedinger and rooted in the landscapes of the Vallée de Joux, the campaign brings together product, craftsmanship and worn moments within one continuous visual language.

advertising.title: VACHERON CONSTANTIN – PATRIMONY 22
advertising.description: A film for the Patrimony, Vacheron Constantin’s purest expression of restraint. Soft light, slow movement, and nothing more than line and proportion, exactly the way the collection has always been designed.

advertising.title: SARTORO – WINTER
advertising.description: A winter campaign shaped as a series of distinct visual moments. Through four scenettes, Sartoro’s jewellery is placed at the heart of an editorial world where elegance, playfulness and contemporary fashion codes come together.

advertisingSecond.title: FRANCK MULLER – WATCHLAND
advertisingSecond.description: A craft film set inside Watchland, Franck Muller’s lakeside estate where every watchmaking métier lives under one roof. We followed a piece from first sketch to final stone, letting the place and its hands tell the story.

advertisingSecond.title: EBEL – 1911 CHRONOGRAPH ICE BLUE
advertisingSecond.description: A film for the 1911 Chronograph Ice Blue, built entirely on one contrast: cool against warm. Ice-blue light, amber shadow, and a dial that lives right on that line.

advertisingSecond.title: MB&F – HM11
advertisingSecond.description: A film for the HM11 Architect, MB&F’s house for the wrist. We set it down in a vast desert and shot it like a building, not a watch, playing on scale until the machine becomes a world of its own.

experience.title: PORTAIL DES NATIONS
experience.description: The world has been shaped here for decades. Now, for the first time, you can experience it from the inside.

selections.title: LA MIF
selections.description: A group of teenage girls have been placed in a residential care home with social workers. This forced “family” experience creates unexpected tensions and intimacies. An incident triggers a chain of over-reactions.

selections.title: L’OFRENA
selections.description: Jan, a mysterious character haunted by a deep feeling of guilt, tries to get Violeta back, a youth love he lost 20 years ago, with a sickening plan.
